equilibrium_formaldehyde_basis: Aqueous formaldehyde pool, predominantly hydrated; distinguished from unhydrated formaldehyde in the original paper's page-3731 reaction-enthalpy discussion and page-3734 equilibrium definitions. Basis checked against indexed OCR of the original paper; the PDF itself could not be rendered for independent visual verification.

association_rate_CN_minus_plus_unhydrate.rate_note: Measured in dilute acetate-buffered aqueous solution; first order in CN- and unhydrated formaldehyde. Only the 298.15 K value is used in the current endpoint timescale screen.

validation_use: Read-only, fixed-pH and fixed-volume endpoint equilibrium potential plus a separate constant-endpoint-state, one-way association timescale. Neither is a coupled reactor yield correction or bound on integrated HCN production. Assay values are absent.
